title: build-check the base overlays with the slice's own logic, or say in the brief that the overlay list was made by a binary older than the slice

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback on ork in ork run ork-20261125-211625-10ac, item S593. The Base overlays section offered `overlay-3` (engine.go reverted) as a test command, but `go vet` on it fails with "e.d.goBin undefined". S593 already makes `baseOverlaySection` run `go vet` on each overlay (`internal/engine/baseoverlay.go:74`), so the cause is a stale binary: the daemon that wrote the brief was built before S593 landed and had no vet step.

Owner decision (adj 591, `review.base-overlays-stale-binary`, "Note in brief"): when the running ork binary is behind the slice's code, the section says so. ork already has this signal as `behind_main` from `Daemon.projectBuild` (`internal/daemon/build.go:142`). The Base overlays section opens with one line saying an older binary made the list and it may offer commands that do not build. S598 does not rebuild the binary and does not vet the overlays another way.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestBaseOverlayNotesOlderBinary (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): with `h.deps.Behind` returning true and one changed Go file, the Base overlays body starts with `Note: an ork binary older than this slice's code made this list, so it may offer commands that do not build.` followed by a blank line. The entry line and its test command are unchanged.
- TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWhenBinaryCurrent (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): with `Behind` nil, and again with `Behind` returning false, the body has no `older than this slice's code` text. The first line of the body is the intro, as today.
- TestBaseOverlayNoteWhenNothingBuilds (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): with `Behind` true and every overlay failing vet, the body still starts with the note, and the entries still read `does not build: ...`.
- TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWithoutGoFiles (`internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`): with `Behind` true and no changed non-test Go file, the brief has no Base overlays section, so the note never appears alone.
- TestRunDepsBehindFollowsDaemonBuild (`internal/daemon/build_test.go`): on a self-host daemon, `d.runs.deps.Behind(ctx, project)` is false when `cfg.BuildID` is the main checkout's revision. It is true after a new commit lands on main. It is false when the build ID is not a commit (`d.cfg.BuildID = "dev"`).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/engine.go`, add a field to `Deps`: `Behind func(ctx context.Context, p registry.Project) bool`. Document it as "reports whether the running ork binary is behind main for the project (S598, *proposed*; adj 591); nil means not behind". Add a method `func (d Deps) behind(ctx context.Context, p registry.Project) bool` that returns false for a nil field.
2. In `internal/daemon/runs.go` `initRunManager`, when `deps.Behind == nil`, set it to a closure that calls `d.projectBuild(ctx, p)` and returns `selfHost && behind`. It uses the same signal as `behind_main`.
3. In `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go` `baseOverlaySection`, after the `len(goFiles) == 0` return and before the body is built, read `e.d.behind(ctx, e.proj)`. When it is true, write `Note: an ork binary older than this slice's code made this list, so it may offer commands that do not build.` plus a blank line as the first text of `body`. Put the text in a named constant. Do not add the note to the early "Check incomplete: the branch diff could not be read" return, because that path has no list.
4. Add the four engine tests to `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`. Reuse `overlayVetHarness` and `overlayVetResult`, and set `h.deps.Behind` before `h.start()`. Use `selfHostDaemon` and `selfHostRepo` in `internal/daemon/build_test.go` for the daemon test.
5. In `docs/design.md`, in the `## Base overlays` bullet (line 2041), add that the section opens with the one-line older-binary note when the daemon is behind main (S598, adj 591).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNotesOlderBinary ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWhenBinaryCurrent ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoteWhenNothingBuilds ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWithoutGoFiles ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestRunDepsBehindFollowsDaemonBuild ./internal/daemon` passes.
- `go test ./...` exits 0, go vet ./... prints nothing, and gofmt -l . prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- [HUMAN CHECK] Start a reviewer round on a self-host daemon that ork daemon status reports as behind main, on a slice that changes a Go file. Open the reviewer brief under the run's role files. The ## Base overlays section should open with the "older than this slice's code" line, and the file entries should follow. After ork daemon restart --rebuild, the next round's section should not show that line.
